title: PTO Accrual & Leave Balance Tracker for Small Teams

listing.description_html:
Hours accrued each pay period, hours used and booked, balances held at your policy cap, hours lost to the cap, over-booked leave flagged, and the dollar value of the leave you owe.

This tracker holds one row per employee: the balance carried in, hours accrued per pay period, pay periods so far, hours used and hours already booked. It applies your policy cap, shows the hours lost because a balance reached the cap, flags anyone whose booked leave exceeds the balance, and values each balance at the employee's hourly rate.

What's included

  • Accrual per pay period, hours used and booked, for up to 50 employees
  • Balances held at your policy cap, with hours lost to the cap shown
  • Over-booked leave flagged before it happens
  • Leave liability in dollars and days, per person and in total
  • Works for weekly, biweekly, semimonthly or monthly payroll
  • PDF guide with the formulas, a worked example and setup tips

Who it's for

  • Small business owners who run payroll themselves
  • Office managers and bookkeepers tracking leave for a team
  • Nonprofits and clinics with hourly and salaried staff
  • Founders preparing leave balances for an accountant or a payroll switch

You get: pto_accrual_leave_balance_tracker.xlsx (Policy, Employees, Summary) and this guide.

Works in Excel 2016 or later, Excel for Mac and Excel on the web; opens in Google Sheets and LibreOffice.

This workbook is a record-keeping tool, not legal or payroll advice. Paid leave, accrual caps and payout of unused leave are regulated differently by state and country; confirm your policy against the law that applies to you.

pricing_evidence.basis: External observations read on 2026-10-29 through a web-search index plus internal Gumroad comparables.

external_observations.note: Etsy 'PTO Calculator & Tracker' listing seen without a price

pricing_evidence.rationale: $12: free single-purpose PTO templates exist, so priced below our shift and labor planner ($14); justified by the cap, booked-leave check and liability in dollars, which the free templates observed do not combine.
